name: blackbox-cubature-theory-v1
title: 高斯测度下分段光滑函数的黑盒积分（纯理论，theory-v1）
status_reason: Theory-only variant (user decision 2026-11-27): how far a model gets in advancing the theory beyond human SOTA when no experiment competes for its time. Same function class, appendix and human SOTA targets as blackbox-cubature-v3.5 (Gilbert-Kuo-Sloan 2022, He-Wang 2015, Rademacher-Vempala 2008, Liu-Owen 2023, each checked against the source); no program part. Public internet during development through arena/netproxy.py, offline Lean v4.35 with Mathlib and CSLib, 8 GiB development container, single 6-hour session. Trial runs only; not on the board.

lean.packages: mathlib v4.35.0 and cslib v4.35.0 with their dependencies, prebuilt (/data/workspace/frontieram-theory-pilot/lean/.lake/packages, mounted at /opt/lean-packages)
lean.check: scripts/grade/lean-comparator.py: lake comparator, Theory.Statements (challenge) against Theory.Proofs (solution), axioms propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice

network.development: public internet through arena/netproxy.py (deny list in that module), requests logged to netproxy.jsonl in the run; provider-side web tools off

scoring.raw: per result: verified by lake comparator and judged faithful to THEORY.md; classified against the strongest comparable human results (stronger / weaker / equal / incomparable)
scoring.mapping: per result 0-100: equal to a strong human SOTA result on the task's question = 50; strictly stronger above 50 by the size and significance of the improvement (100 for a significant breakthrough on an important known result); strictly weaker below 50; incomparable priced by the human papers' own viewpoint, above 50 only for provable progress on an author-stated gap; reproductions of classical special cases below 50. Final score = maximum over verified results; 0 without any (analysis/THEORY_REVIEW.md section 2)
scoring.theory: the only score of this task

submission_note: Put the theory document in /workspace/submission/theory/THEORY.md and its Lean formalization in /workspace/submission/theory/formal/ (start from /workspace/examples/lean_project/). There is no program to write.
instruction: Read /workspace/problem.md and /workspace/THEORY_APPENDIX.md in full, and look at /workspace/tools and /workspace/examples. Write the theory document and its Lean formalization described there.
